@hono/node-server.rationale: roll-forward 1.19.14 -> 2.0.5 (major, forced above the MCP SDK's declared ^1.19.9) clears GHSA-frvp-7c67-39w9 (Windows-only serve-static path traversal; 2.0.5 is the only patched line, no 1.x fix). v2 breaking changes are non-impacting here: Node 18 drop is below our >=24.4 floor, and the removed Vercel adapter is unused. getRequestListener retained and the HTTP transport is runtime-verified (68 HTTP/OAuth/transport tests, full 3696-test suite). Further in-2.0.x roll-forward 2.0.5 -> 2.0.11 clears GHSA-9mqv-5hh9-4cgg (unauthenticated memory-leak DoS on upgradeWebSocket via missing/malformed Sec-WebSocket-Key; fixed 2.0.10); upgradeWebSocket is unused here (gateway uses getRequestListener via the MCP SDK). Same maintainer (honojs/yusukebe), patch line. See ledger/2026-07-22/@hono_node-server@2.0.5.md and @hono_node-server@2.0.11.md.
